Description: Verify a 409 txn_id collision on the findByTxnId path writes exactly one payment_attempts row with outcome 'MISMATCH' (not 'SUCCESS'); the SQL-seeded pass writes no audit row, so the colliding gateway call leaves exactly one audit row total
PreRequisites: Mock POST /external/payment/charge to return HTTP 200 with JSON {'status': 'SUCCESS', 'txn_id': 'audit-txn-<dynamic_id>'}; Execute SQL: INSERT INTO passes (vehicle, months, plate, price, txn_id, status) VALUES ('car', 1, 'AU<dynamic_id>', 100, 'audit-txn-<dynamic_id>', 'ACTIVE');
ExpectedResult: HTTP 409 Conflict. JSON contains {'detail': 'txn_id already used for a different purchase'}
Post-Assertions: Execute SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM payment_attempts WHERE txn_id = 'audit-txn-<dynamic_id>' AND outcome = 'MISMATCH' -> Expected: 1; Execute SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM payment_attempts WHERE txn_id = 'audit-txn-<dynamic_id>' -> Expected: 1; Execute SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM passes WHERE txn_id = 'audit-txn-<dynamic_id>' -> Expected: 1
Teardown: Execute SQL: DELETE FROM payment_attempts WHERE txn_id = 'audit-txn-<dynamic_id>'; DELETE FROM passes WHERE txn_id = 'audit-txn-<dynamic_id>';
